profile: Hilton operates hotels and timeshare brands across luxury, lifestyle, full-service, focused-service and all-suites categories. It manages hotels for third-party owners and franchises its brands, booking channels and related programs, while also owning and operating hotels that sell rooms, food, beverages and other services. Hilton provides hotel owners with management, licensing and contracted services, and serves travelers through its properties and Hilton Honors guest loyalty program.
